objective: Test whether contrast-aware, product-fit generation can add semantically faithful supervision for eight V1-omitted or severely low-support Product-18 labels, repair the unstable love boundary, and create genuine two-label Events.
evidenceBasis: V1 generator-fidelity audit only. RTN and per-row COSO evidence are excluded.

generationPlan.emptyContrasts: 2 for each of the nine single-label targets
generationPlan.whyThisSize: Twelve independent single-label trials per weak label permit an 8/12 exact-hit gate without broad regeneration; six trials per pair yield 30 multi-label rows, enough to test the unchanged minimum-15 resolved two-label requirement; 18 empty contrasts test boundary restraint.

semanticConstraints.amusement: A concrete funny, playful, or entertaining trigger; not generic positive outcome, contentment, or future anticipation.
semanticConstraints.annoyance: Mild irritation from a limited bothersome event; no serious boundary violation, hostility, danger, or large consequence that would imply anger or fear.
semanticConstraints.caring: Active concern or support for another's wellbeing; not mere closeness/love and not appreciation for help received.
semanticConstraints.confusion: Conflicting, missing, or unclear information blocks understanding or action; not an active desire to explore or learn.
semanticConstraints.disappointment: A specific prior expectation or hoped-for result is unmet; not generic loss or sadness without expectation.
semanticConstraints.gratitude: Another person's intentional help directly benefits the author; not admiration, caring toward the helper, or generic affection.
semanticConstraints.joy: A favorable outcome has already happened and produces clear present positive response; not future optimism or high-energy anticipation.
semanticConstraints.love: Distinctive ongoing attachment or closeness; not merely receiving help, politeness, family-role mention, or sadness from separation.
semanticConstraints.surprise: The event or outcome is notably unexpected; positive/negative arousal must not dominate unless the row is an intended pair.
semanticConstraints.twoLabel: Both labels have independent evidence in one coherent event; neither is a synonym and no unrelated clauses are concatenated.
semanticConstraints.emptyContrast: Surface vocabulary resembles the paired label family, but the event remains routine and supplies no reasonable Product-18 emotional evidence.

forbidden: emotion-label words used as answer hints
this made me feel X templates

blindValidation.visibility: Only rowId, Event text, Product-18 definitions, and 0-2 output policy. Intended target, V1 audit, generator, other outputs, incumbent, RTN, and COSO are hidden.
blindValidation.consensus: HIGH=3/3 exact set; MEDIUM=2/3 exact set; UNRESOLVED=no exact 2/3; no fourth adjudicator or human review.

generatorQualityGate.mechanical: 156 unique valid Events; exact/normalized/TF-IDF near duplicates 0; transition/repeated-clause/repeated-five-word-suffix types 0; product-fit failures 0.
generatorQualityGate.agreement: HIGH>=60, RESOLVED>=130, UNRESOLVED<=26; every pairwise exact-set agreement rate>=0.45.
generatorQualityGate.singleLabelFidelity: For each of nine labels: 12 intended, RESOLVED>=10, exact target hit>=8, target included>=9, empty consensus<=2.
generatorQualityGate.coverage: All nine targets have consensus support>=8; no target has zero or severe support below 5; no label exceeds 25% of all resolved label assignments.
generatorQualityGate.multiLabelFidelity: Across 30 intended pair rows: RESOLVED>=24, exact pair hit>=18, both targets included>=21, resolved two-label outputs>=18; every pair has at least 3 exact hits.
generatorQualityGate.emptyContrast: Across 18 intended-empty rows: RESOLVED>=15 and exact empty>=12.
generatorQualityGate.failure: DO_NOT_TRAIN. Do not lower a gate, add emergency examples, rerun validators, change target counts, or add a fourth model.

trainingBoundary: No training protocol is selected until and unless every generator-quality gate passes. RTN and per-row COSO remain unopened throughout generation and validation.
